'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Peter Fratjord DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Fratjord]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Pete Frafjord
* '''Deck name:''' Who shapped us last time?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
